description: USE THIS to verify an SSCC (GS1 Serial Shipping Container Code — identifies a pallet/carton/logistics unit) from a shipping label before relying on it. Checks the 18-digit GS1 mod-10 check digit and returns the extension digit and GS1 prefix country. Validates structure only.

sscc.description: The 18-digit SSCC; spaces and dashes are ignored.

name: validate_sscc
